decisions.decision: markTransferInterrupted uses a plain update() not WriteBatch — only one doc is touched
decisions.rationale: Receiver-side abort doc update; no cross-collection atomicity needed

decisions.decision: writeConnectionLostAuditLog uses WriteBatch to write to both sender + receiver auditLogs
decisions.rationale: Both participants need an audit record; atomicity prevents partial logging
